scope_reason: Full personal-note suite and four PDF suites on the exact combined candidate, with 659 expected successes. Fifteen RED assertions cover mutation acknowledgements, empty-list Backspace, Windows Alt line deletion and draft lifecycle races. No-Save navigation, pending cleanup, same-key drafts and repeated Alt remain mandatory product controls. Issue 3260 remains a known pre-existing hidden-marks bug on both base and candidate: two shown-marks reader controls must pass and two hidden-marks assertions must fail at the exact known source-text mismatch. A separate QA-only overlay of the original pinned PR3036 source and its two test files must pass all four unchanged reader cases and the three plugin suites. The overlay is not part of the product and is always restored.
draft_red_status: Independently reviewed source scenarios; actual baseline failures and target successes remain mandatory.
